# Maze

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: User-research product marketing: a warm neutral page, Phonic light display, a pill and a near-black demo button, an oklch palette, and a blue login action on an Inter card.

Captured 2026-11-18, signed-out public marketing, pricing, the auth login card, and one published sample report. No study started. No form submitted. No purchase.. Themes: light.

Tokens and component notes for Maze (maze.co), captured **2026-11-18**. Desktop is 1440×900. Phone is 390×844. One light theme. Public routes: `/`, `/pricing/`, `/platform/`, `/platform/ux-reporting/`, `/customers/`, `/demo/`, `/resources/user-research-report/`, `auth.maze.co/login`, and the published sample report at `app.maze.co/report/[share-link]`. Signed out the whole time. No study was started. No form was submitted. No purchase.

Maze marketing is Next.js and Tailwind v4. Colour is an oklch custom-property palette on `:root` (`--color-neutral-*`, `--color-blue-*`, lime, cyan, purple, red, yellow). Display is Phonic, self-hosted. Auth and the report paint Inter and a blue action, `rgb(5, 104, 253)`.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- Studies, the app past login, and signup. `app.maze.co` redirects to login. Starter's "Sign up now" was not clicked. The survey at `t.maze.co` was not opened.
- The demo form and the footer newsletter. Both were left empty.
- The phone report. At 390 it paints "Window size too small" and asks for 800px.
- Phonic and Inter files. The family names are measured. The files are not in this package.
- Pressed states. They are forced pseudo-classes.
- The desktop platform menu shot was forced visible after hover missed in the capture session. The panel contents are the live DOM. The open animation is not.
- The home viewport shot is the top 900px of the full-page capture. Lenis can leave a viewport screenshot mid-scroll while reporting `scrollY` 0.
- `--color-neutral-800` (`#454545`) is lighter than `--color-neutral-700` (`#1c1c1c`). That is the declared scale, not a sorted ramp.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do paint the page on neutral 100 and the cards on white.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do set the hero in Phonic light.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do use a pill for Try Maze for free and a near-black fill for Get a demo.** [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Do use the blue action on Log in and on the report Sign up.** [login-light-default](screenshots/login-light-default.png)
- **Do keep the login card at 8px radius on a lime collage.** [login-light-default](screenshots/login-light-default.png)
- **Don't invent a dark theme.** The captured surfaces paint one light theme. [pricing-light-default](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png)
- **Don't start a study from the promo bar.** [home-light-full](screenshots/home-light-full.png)
- **Don't submit the demo form or the login form.** [demo-light-default](screenshots/demo-light-default.png)
- **Don't treat the phone report as the product.** It asks for 800px. [mobile-report-light-default](screenshots/mobile-report-light-default.png)
- **Don't ship the Phonic files.** The family name is the token. [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
